note: Declared assumptions. The intent mix and personas shape what is asked; which turns really need history is measured afterwards, not taken from this file.

finance.experience: Working through a company's annual report
finance.assistant: You are an assistant that answers questions about a company's annual report (Form 10-K).

personas.who: an equity analyst starting coverage of this company
personas.goal: understand what drives revenue and margins and what changed this year

personas.who: a credit analyst at a lender
personas.goal: judge liquidity, debt and the risks to repayment

personas.who: a procurement manager vetting this company as a supplier
personas.goal: find out how stable the business is and where it depends on a few customers or suppliers

personas.who: a business student writing a case study
personas.goal: describe the business model, the competition and the main risks in plain terms

legal.assistant: You are an assistant that answers questions about a commercial contract.

personas.who: an in-house lawyer reviewing this agreement before renewal
personas.goal: list the obligations, the termination rights and anything unusual

personas.who: a founder who has to sign a similar agreement
personas.goal: understand what each side commits to and where the risk sits

personas.who: a contract manager preparing a compliance checklist
personas.goal: extract deadlines, notice periods, payment terms and reporting duties

personas.who: a paralegal summarising the agreement for a partner
personas.goal: produce an accurate clause-by-clause overview

healthcare.experience: Asking about a medicine from its official label
healthcare.assistant: You are an assistant that answers questions about a medicine from its official prescribing information. You give information from the label, not personal medical advice.

personas.who: a community pharmacist checking details before counselling a patient
personas.goal: confirm dosing, interactions and what to warn the patient about

personas.who: an adult who has just been prescribed this medicine
personas.goal: understand how to take it, what side effects to expect and when to call a doctor

personas.who: a nurse on a hospital ward
personas.goal: check administration, monitoring and adjustments for particular patients

personas.who: a relative caring for an older patient on this medicine
personas.goal: know the practical do's and don'ts and the warning signs

support.assistant: You are a support assistant that answers questions from the product documentation.

personas.who: a platform engineer running a production cluster
personas.goal: set this up correctly and avoid outages

personas.who: a developer new to the product
personas.goal: get a first working setup and understand the concepts involved

personas.who: an on-call engineer in the middle of an incident
personas.goal: find out why something is failing and how to fix it

personas.who: a team lead planning a migration
personas.goal: understand the options, their limits and what has to change

hr.experience: Asking an internal handbook about policies and how things work
hr.assistant: You are an assistant that answers staff questions from the organisation's handbook.

personas.who: a new employee in their first month
personas.goal: find out how things work here and what is expected

personas.who: an employee planning time away
personas.goal: understand the rules and the steps to take

personas.who: a new supervisor
personas.goal: learn what the handbook asks of people who manage others

personas.who: a long-serving employee who rarely reads the handbook
personas.goal: check a few specific rules before making a request
